measurement: Utility families beyond the ones already found, probed per market in the local language
brief_section: Brief 8 section 10 and 16: do not stop at the tools already found; search systematically for calculator, estimator, affordability, cost, comparison intents
method: keywords-explorer matching-terms, match_mode=terms, terms=all, local country and local-language roots. Volume floors set per market so a small market is not judged against a large one.

the_standout_finding.why_it_matters: This is the best ratio of demand to difficulty found anywhere in the project: 52,000 searches a month against a difficulty of 5. It is also pure arithmetic. Overpaying a loan shortens its term and cuts total interest, and that is computable from principal, rate, term and the overpayment alone, with no official table and no licence. Nothing is blocking it.
the_standout_finding.the_serp_is_not_empty_though: Bank-branded variants sit beneath the head term: nationwide 800 at difficulty 55, mse 700, natwest 500, halifax 500, martin lewis 450 at a CPC of 6 dollars. The unbranded head term is the open one; the branded queries belong to those brands and are recorded as theirs.

de-DE.the_local_specific: hauskauf nebenkosten is the German property purchase cost, and it is Bundesland-scoped: the Grunderwerbsteuer rate differs by state, from 3.5 to 6.5 per cent, and the notary and land registry fees are statutory. So this family is one page per Bundesland, not one page for Germany, which is the same subdivision shape the Pulse measurement found. The tax deduction cluster around umzugskosten steuer is also German law and has no equivalent in the other markets.

nl-NL.the_local_specific: kosten koper at 5,000 and difficulty 0 is the Dutch buyer-pays-costs convention, and it needs the overdrachtsbelasting rate, which is 2 per cent normally, 10.4 per cent for an investor and 0 for a first-time buyer under a price cap. That is Dutch regulation, so the page is source-required and must carry the year. The parent topic of huur berekenen is puntensysteem huur, the Dutch points system that caps regulated rents: a legal instrument with no equivalent elsewhere, and a genuine utility if the points table is sourced.

en-US.the_local_specific: The American payoff cluster is the same utility as the British overpayment one under a different name, which is the section 2 case exactly: same utility, different local keyword, its own demand. Difficulty differs sharply, 5 in Britain against 54 in America, so they are not one page in two languages, they are two pages with different prospects. closing cost is state-scoped like the German Nebenkosten is Bundesland-scoped.

found.note: gotówkowego is a cash loan, a separate product from the mortgage

pl-PL.the_local_specific: 13,000 a month at difficulty ZERO. Polish borrowers overpay because the loans are variable rate, which is the same reason the earlier wave found o ile wzrośnie rata, a rate-change calculator. The cash-loan variant is a distinct product and a distinct page.

fr-FR.the_local_specific: frais de notaire are the French statutory purchase costs, set by a published barème of émoluments plus droits de mutation. 16,000 a month with a 52,000 traffic potential, and the year-stamped variants confirm the page must carry its year and its source date, because the barème changes.

umzugskosten 1,900 and moving cost calculator 2,500 at a 5 dollar CPC are real demand, but a moving cost is a quote, not a calculation. Without a price dataset the page would have to invent figures, so it is recorded and refused

tools.loan-overpayment.note: This is what section 20 means by not forcing every family into every locale. The same utility, measured in five languages, is a 52,000-a-month open field in Britain, a 13,000-a-month open field in Poland, and 300 a month against entrenched competition in Italy. A family is not a property of the site, it is a property of the family AND the locale.

tools.property-purchase-costs.note: One family, five markets, and in three of them it is REGIONAL rather than national: the German Grunderwerbsteuer differs by Bundesland, American closing costs by state, and the Dutch rate depends on whether the buyer is a first-timer under a price cap. So the page count is not five, it is five plus the subdivisions, and every one of them needs a statutory table with a version date.
